title: GenerationFeedback
description: What somebody did with a generated piece when it was handed to them: took it, threw it away, or rewrote it. An act rather than an opinion — the rewrite is the feedback, and it is the one signal that says what good would have looked like.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

generation.description: The id of the generated piece this was done to, in the system that owns it.

session.description: The id of the working session it happened in, in the system that holds it. Not a person: a session says the acts came from one sitting, and whether anybody is named is the holding system's business.

editedOutput.description: The piece as they rewrote it. Present when the action was edited; that it must be is a rule the writing system keeps, not a shape.
